The '''Explorer Mk. V''' was a model of [[Explorer droid/Legends|exploration droid]] created by [[Smitroo Industries]]. 1.8 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, loyal, and very resilient, only 500 of the droids were produced. Smitroo sent the droids out with its [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] to find worlds the company could exploit. After Smitroo went bankrupt, the droids sought new masters, scouts (such as in the [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services|New Republic Scout Service]]) who would assist them in achieving their original mission. The droids hoped to find the [[Smitroo Board of Directors]] and report their findings to them. The model's large size tended to intimidate those unfamiliar with the model.
